description: Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich, Geomatik + Vermessung and Statistik Stadt Zürich) publishes the locations of the hospitals in the City of Zürich, and in a companion dataset the locations of the hospital emergency departments, each as CSV, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile and DXF, published to feed the city website and city map. Coverage: the City of Zürich; both portal records were last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, DXF, GPKG, JSON, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, WMTS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: both datasets are point locations; bed counts, capacity and service levels are not in the portal description, and the files were not opened. Simulation uses: healthcare facility layers for accessibility, ambulance-response and surge-capacity models, and as critical-facility exposure in flood and power-outage studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
